mentions.name: Elixir/Phoenix coding agent review dashboard
mentions.description: A web dashboard built with Elixir and Phoenix for manually and closely reviewing coding agent plans and code patches. It is used for the author's day job and has reached the point where the dashboard can be used to work on the dashboard itself.
mentions.problem: No way yet figured out to live-reload the dashboard itself after adding a feature or fixing a bug.
mentions.audience: The author uses it for their day job reviewing coding agent output.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am vibecoding a elixir/phoenix agent dashboard to manually & closely review the coding agent plans and code patches for my day job.

evidence.value: I am vibecoding a elixir/phoenix agent dashboard to manually & closely review the coding agent plans and code patches for my day job.
